how_to_switch_at_an_update_boundary: 1. Pick a REGISTERED alternative only: 0.045 (current), 0.06 or 0.09. Anything else is refused by prepare_intent, bind_runtime and the monitor (fail closed).

2. Re-prepare the runtime at an update boundary k -> k+1: v2v_runner.prepare_intent(..., imitation_kl_limit=0.06) writes config['imitation_kl_limit']=0.06 (B and R together; prepare refuses non-registered values).

3. Re-bind the deployment: reissue the additive launch3 authority (LAUNCH3_AUTHORITY.json + qualified binding + SHA) pinning the NEW runtime hash; v2v_launch3.bind_runtime accepts any registered value with B == R and refuses the rest (a stale imitation_kl_cap claim that disagrees with the new limit refuses too).

4. On child start, v2v_live.hooks reads imitation_kl_limit_for(cfg, 'B'/'R') and bank_imitation.install(kl_limit=...) binds it process-wide; every bank_imitation.run_separate call then reports kl_limit=0.06 and bounds all acceptance checks and the kl_targeted growth threshold (limit/2) by it.

5. learningwatch reads the pinned limit from the hash-verified V2V_RUNTIME.json and fails closed on any receipt whose kl_limit differs from it; the per-update safety note (total_kl_vs_pre_update and, for a limit above .045, the report-only total_kl_above_ppo_stop_plus_limit flag) appears in every receipt of a non-default runtime.
6. The bank step mode (imitation_step_mode) is unchanged by this option; both keys stay one-value-for-B-and-R and are only flipped at a registered update boundary via the same re-bind procedure.
